title: Summit Operations Platform — Check-in & Occupancy
summary: A lightweight operations tool built for the UC Riverside School of Business Emerging Careers Summit: QR check-in, role-based staff workflows, and real-time session occupancy — so a live event could be run and watched from one screen.
problem: A real event with a fixed date needed to onboard attendees at the door, keep sessions from overfilling, and give organizers live visibility — without clipboards, manual tallies, or after-the-fact reconciliation.
approach: Built the tool in Streamlit backed by the Google Sheets API, so organizers could read and edit the same source of truth they already trusted with no separate database to stand up. Attendees check in by QR; UCR email validation keeps the roster clean. Staff get role-based views — a Floor Host flow for the door and an Admin flow for oversight — with live occupancy and capacity monitoring, capacity alerts when a room fills, session reassignment when it does, and an administrative export at the end.
outcome: Ran the live Summit end to end: 120+ attendee check-ins across 18 sessions, with organizers watching occupancy in real time and reassigning attendees on the fly instead of turning people away at a full room.
team: Built for event organizers + floor staff
duration: UCR School of Business · Emerging Careers Summit
